future_check: The old generator passed ordinary lint and Racket smoke because its emitted positive examples were executable; those gates did not detect its toothless self_check, false axes, unreachable thin rectangle, or invalid negative lessons. Focused semantic and override checks now cover those failures.; The strict public-profile rate is intentionally about 31%, not 100%: complete official tuples remain linked while the remaining curriculum teaches rule-consistent counterexamples to single-rectangle, non-overlap, wide-only, and interior-only shortcuts.; Generalized three-color and edge-touching scenes are principled rule extrapolations beyond the public maximum of two colors and mostly interior layouts, so coverage and training suitability are conservatively tier 3.; Public profiles may repeat geometry after nuisance recoloring/translation/symmetry; the pooled diversity remains 100% unique inputs and 99% unique outputs over 300 pairs, and every downstream episode is distinct.; The 1361.226ms maximum Racket time is a one-time backend startup outlier; p50 is 2.099ms and p95 is 2.560ms.; Published held-out output was used only for repository-authorized rule verification. The generator stores input geometry profiles but no output table; outputs are constructed by the live rule.; Worker evidence is a candidate repair until independent monitor v13 replays the current-source gates and binds this record digest to the source hash.
rationale: VERSION 2.1.1 -> 3.0.0 and pinned the canonical rule at af34f04ae393.; Replaced nine coupled, dead, or contradictory axes with one exact scene_profile control recoverable from every returned grid.; Added a 31.25% default-only whole-profile prior retaining all four train inputs and the held-out input as linked geometry, with color, translation, and D4 orientation treated as nuisance.; Added lawful single, thin, edge-touching, disjoint multi-color, and overlapping-bbox profiles; the thin profile restores the official 2-column morphology the old generator excluded.; Removed invalid degenerate lessons and added an exact semantic analyzer, strong self_check, override observer, and independent Python rule mirror.; Synchronized the base executable target text with the canonical Racket authority and added focused regression tests.
summary: For each nonzero color independently, find its three cells, take their axis-aligned bounding box, and paint the one absent bbox corner that color; preserve every input cell.
